name: Agent Skills specification
notes: The specification has no version string, no git tag and no release. A commit SHA plus the blob SHA of docs/specification.mdx is the strongest identifier available, which is why both are pinned rather than a version.
It moved: github.com/anthropics/skills spec/agent-skills-spec.md is now an 87-byte redirect to agentskills.io, and that repository is a sample collection rather than the specification.

There is no JSON Schema. The reference validator skills-ref (Python, click + strictyaml) is the only executable statement of the rules, so where the prose and skills-ref disagree this repository follows skills-ref and says so in ADR-044.

Anthropic's Skills API adds requirements the open specification does not state (no XML tags in name or description, reserved words, a 30 MB upload ceiling). Those are platform requirements, not specification requirements, and are kept out of the conformance check for that reason.
